finding: The geometry preserves cell rigidity and retained hinge matches; strict projection keeps identities even when visible geometry coincides.
limitations: Full-size cube markers and their transition are teaching displays, not literal 3D projections or physical deformations.
Projection coincidence is not source identity or collision.
No demonstrated teaching benefit, general hidden-W inference or native Arepo integration.
Desktop WebKit and narrow touch emulation do not establish physical iPhone loading or pinch behavior.
method: Exact source incidence, seven retained hinges, full-cell teaching markers, declared interpolation to XYZ projection and versioned study replay.
open_questions: Which representation helps a visitor follow a cell after its visual separation and labels disappear?
